title: Composition coherence of the specified integral pull comparison
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a normed extension of ℚ_ℓ, and k a field of prime characteristic different from ℓ. Let h:T→U and j:U→V be k-morphisms of separated finite-type k-schemes. For K in the integral bounded constructible category on V, write T_W for the specified integral scalar extension, α_h for the specified pull comparison, and c_I,c_E for the specified bounded pullback composition comparisons of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-comparisons] and [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Then T_T(c_I(h,j)_K) followed by α_h at j_I^*K and h_E^*(α_j at K) equals α_(h≫j) at K followed by c_E(h,j) at T_V K, as an equality of isomorphisms. No pushforward comparison, base-change arrow, properness or cartesianity is part of this statement.

proof.text: Before deriving, restriction of scalars commutes with the pushforward composition comparison. The private calculation comap_lowerStar_comp applies Mod.hom_ext: all coefficient comparison components are identities and both paths have the same underlying sheaf pushforward composition component.

Right derive that square with the specified composition units. The private calculations comp_unit_app, comp_map_fac and comp_fac identify the composite unit and its factorization through the exact-functor and pushforward composition comparisons. The calculation square_fac characterizes the derived restriction/pushforward comparison by that unit. In square_comp, test on K-injective representatives using Localization.natTrans_ext, cancel the invertible composite unit, and use the degreewise underived square and naturality. Pushforwards and coefficient restrictions preserve K-injectives because their left adjoints are exact. Instantiating this generic calculation gives derived_comap_comp. The exact-right factorization uses the existing rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso_hom_fac and rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryUnit_app' theorems, rather than the retired comparison-equality name.

Conjugate the equality through the scalar and pullback adjunctions. The private calculation pull_comparison_pasting uses conjugateEquiv_comp and its whiskering and associator formulas. The calculation derived_lowerStar_conjugate identifies the specified left-derived pullback composition with the conjugate right-derived pushforward comparison, using rightDerivedFunctorCompIso'_hom_eq_conjugateEquiv and derived_eq_ofNatIsoLeft. Together these give derived_pull_comp for arbitrary flat condensed coefficient changes. Finally bounded_comp_hom identifies the bounded constructible composition map with the ambient derived map. Apply Iso.ext and ObjectProperty.hom_ext, substitute these identifications, and evaluate the ambient natural-transformation equality at K. The transport equation is instantiated at the fixed upper-star functor and rearranged using Iso.eq_inv_comp; the final restriction uses focused component rewrites through the bounded-category inclusions.

theorem integralConstructiblePullIso_comp
    {T U : Scheme.{u}} [T.Over (Spec (.of k))] [U.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (T ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (T ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (T ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (U ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] (h : T ⟶ U) [h.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    {V : Scheme.{u}} [V.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (V ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (V ↘ Spec (.of k))] (j : U ⟶ V) [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    (K : integralConstructible ℓ E V) :
    (integralScalarConstructible ℓ E T).mapIso
        ((boundedConstructibleUpperStarComp (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (h.asOver (Spec (.of k))) (j.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app K) ≪≫
      integralConstructiblePullIso ℓ E k h
        ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (j.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj K) ≪≫
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (h.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).mapIso
        (integralConstructiblePullIso ℓ E k j K) =
    integralConstructiblePullIso ℓ E k (h ≫ j) K ≪≫
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStarComp (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (h.asOver (Spec (.of k))) (j.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app
        ((integralScalarConstructible ℓ E V).obj K)
